title: Second Course in Halberd Handling
summary: A second course that adds arc and drive moves to the basics for students who already hold a Basic halberd manual.

title: Axe Head and Spike Combined
summary: A text on switching between axe head and spike inside one exchange so the opponent never settles on a guard.

title: The Reaching Axe: Middle Studies
summary: Middle studies in using full reach with qi and then recovering the footing before the opponent can close.

title: Treatise on Hook and Haft and Heel
summary: A treatise on tripping pinning and throwing with the hook the haft and the heel of the halberd together.

title: A Soldier's Halberd Compendium
summary: A compendium of halberd work for the ranks covering marching carry bracing against a charge and hauling a rider down.

title: Qi Along the Shaft
summary: A short text on running qi along the haft so strikes carry further and guards ring firm against heavy blows.

title: The Halberd Against Spear and Sword
summary: A study of how the halberd answers a spear or a sword by using its beak and its reach in counter.

title: Middle Canon of the Beaked Axe
summary: A middle canon on the beak of the halberd as a piercing and raking tool and not only a hook.

title: Pole-Arm Lessons for Line Drills
summary: Lessons for halberd drills in close formation teaching shoulder to shoulder cuts thrusts and the closing of gaps.

title: Intermediate Halberd Sequences
summary: A set of fixed halberd sequences that chain chops thrusts and hooks into three-beat and longer runs.

title: Halberd Workbook
summary: A handbook for halberd line soldiers on drawing from hiding and breaking the head of a marching column wagon by wagon.

title: Light Halberd Notes
summary: Notes for quick halberd skirmishers on moving unseen along hedge and ditch and cutting the load and the guard from the flank of a wagon.
